name: Latch Slipping
description: Many spring latches can be slipped back into the door using a thin shim inserted into the door gap, bypassing the lock entirely. The Jim tool and Mica shims are designed for this purpose. The technique is effective on doors where the latch is exposed in the frame gap — a common condition in commercial buildings where door frames are misaligned or where the strike plate does not fully cover the latch bolt. This is one of the most frequently successful bypass techniques in real engagements.

blue.det: Door open alert if door state is monitored; physical evidence of latch damage or shim marks on door edge; camera footage of entry.
blue.cm: Deadbolt required alongside spring latch for all exterior doors; door position sensors tied to alarm; anti-shimming latch guards; door gap reduction via proper frame installation.
